selection.rationale: Chosen for fewer separate candidate locations, then more readable moments and fewer interpretations; ties use the track ID. This prioritizes a bounded investigation, not gameplay importance. Predictions were frozen before the scheduled fresh observations. No edits are automatic.

input_context.limitation: Sampled Windows virtual-key states while the selected window was foreground. Keys are not translated into text. Zero can mean up or unavailable; short taps and changes between polls may be missed. Focus checks are best-effort. These are not delivered game inputs, continuous holds, button meanings or causal effects. Mouse motion, wheel, gamepads and audio are not sampled.
